question: Who has been appointed as new director of AIIMS, New Delhi in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** M. Srinivas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian physician Dr. M. Srinivas** hails from the Indian state of **Karnataka.**
 
• He was appointed as the **director of AIIMS** on **September 9, 2022,** for a term of** five years** or until he was **65**, whichever came first.
 
• **Randeep Guleria**, who has held the position since **March 2017,** was succeeded by him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
